subject: Inner wake ACK is not presentation readiness
body: HEAD=413d4a722fe8193f15ff086595f10d1464505ace. SOURCE-CONFIRMED: Fold7ContinuityCoordinator.wakeInner() measures coroutine queue time plus the synchronous Shizuku WAKE_INNER_DISPLAY call. DuoShellService.wakeInnerPhysicalDisplay() resolves the 1968x2184 physical display and invokes hidden SurfaceControl.setDisplayPowerMode(token, 2), then returns physicalPowered=true if that call succeeds. It does not observe a logical inner Display becoming STATE_ON, a SurfaceFlinger frame targeting the panel, a HWC present fence, or the first Duo/app frame presented. Existing displayProbe is intentionally delayed/debounced and is not a transition-latency instrument. AOSP Android 16 further shows setPowerMode waits for SurfaceFlinger main-thread processing and HWC setPowerMode, schedules composition, and does not switch active display when another active internal display remains powered; this is useful generic evidence but Samsung Fold7 must be validated physically. RECOMMENDATION: treat wakeInnerDisplay().ok as command/HWC-power-call completion, not presentation readiness. Measure edge->SF/HWC power->logical topology/state->first SF DisplayFrame/present->first Duo frame on one timebase before changing the wake threshold or ownership behavior.
